summary: Mrs. Setton discusses the mitzvah of sitting in a sukkah during the holiday of Sukkot. She explores the meaning of the clouds of glory and how the sukkah helps us recognize Hashem in simple things.
questions: Why are we commanded to sit in a sukkah?
What does the word hoshavti teach us about the sukkah?
How does the sukkah relate to the clouds of glory?
How can we see Hashem in simple things?
